QuestInfo.name: Little Priest's Request 1
QuestInfo.0:
A little boy who looks like a priest is alone in the general store.
Ask him what he needs help with.
QuestInfo.1:
It looks like little priest Shadi needs materials for a sword to gift to his older brother. 
Go to #b#m410007513##k, defeat #b#o8645350##k, obtain #b10 #t4009487##k, and go to #bHydar#k.
QuestInfo.2: Hydar asked you to wait while he works on refining the sword.

npc.0: You can take the weapon materials directly to the #bweapon store#k. If you give them to #bHydar#k, he will refine the weapon for you.

item.0: I need #bMarauder Swords#k from #bSloppy Marauders#k for my work. #b10#k of them should do.
